title: Structural-coordinate normalization of affine etale realization
statement: Let f:X→S be quasi-compact and separated [def-pc-scheme], and E a quasi-coherent O_S-module [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. Suppose that for every affine scheme T and g:T→S there is a Γ(T,O_T)-linear equivalence e_g:H¹(X×_S T,pr_X^*O_X)≃Γ(T,g^*E), natural for the canonical cohomology pullback and section-normalized restriction [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-affine-base-change-edge-naturality]. Then H¹(Rf_*(O_X,et[0])) is isomorphic to E_et in the common additive coefficient universe [def-pbc-canonical-coherent-etale-comparison]. This isomorphism has the following structural scalar normalization on every etale U→S: for a∈Γ(U,O_U), let μ be any endomorphism of the localized actual additive structure coefficient which on every etale test object T multiplies its structural function coordinate by (T→U)^*a. If the canonical raw restricted cohomology evaluations of z,z′ differ by H¹(μ), the images of their canonical higher-direct-image classes differ by a. No properness, smoothness, curve, Noetherian, degree-zero or local-freeness assumption is made.

proof.text: Transport the ordinary affine coherent comparison family, retaining linearity and restriction naturality.
Apply the existing affine-cohomology etale realization theorem to the unit module, using the transported comparisons. Keep its coherent-class action and linearity equations.
Apply structural scalar normalization to this given realization. The conclusion is the required isomorphism for actual additive structural functions with its prescribed raw scalar equation.

theorem exists_unitAffineCohomologyEtaleRealization {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f] (E : S.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (e : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ S) (_ : IsAffine T),
      coherentEdgeH f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) g ≃ₗ[Γ(T, ⊤)]
        (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor T.toRingedSpace).obj
          ((tensorPullback g).obj E))
    (e_natural : ∀ (T T' : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ S) (h : T' ⟶ T)
      (hT : IsAffine T) (hT' : IsAffine T')
      (x : coherentEdgeH f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) g),
      e T' (h ≫ g) hT' (coherentEdgePullback f
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) g h x) =
      coherentEdgeRho g h E (e T g hT x)) :
    ∃ Φ : unitRealizationImage f ≅
          liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf E,
      UnitRealizationScalar f E Φ
